geo.about_text:
PRODUCT INFORMATION & COPYRIGHT:
• Application Name: GeoSolver
• Version: 2.5 (Official Release November 2026)
• Computational Engine: Python Tkinter CAD Engine & SymPy CAS Solver.
• Copyright & Author: © 2026 GeoSolver. All Rights Reserved.

STRICT LEGAL NOTICE & INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY:
All rights reserved. Any unauthorized reproduction, decompilation, reverse engineering,
distribution, commercial exploitation, or adaptation of this software in whole or in part
is strictly prohibited and constitutes an infringement of intellectual property laws (WIPO/TRIPS).
Violators will be prosecuted to the maximum extent permitted by law.

SECURITY & DIGITAL SIGNATURE READINESS:
• Verification Standard: PKI / RSA-4096 / SHA-256 Cryptographic Integrity Seal.
• Status: READY FOR AUTHOR DIGITAL SIGNATURE & TIMESTAMP AUTHORITY (TSA) SEAL.

KEY FEATURES:
1. MS Office 2003 / Cabri II Plus Clean Interface:
   - Organized 4-row compact toolbars, ~30% smaller button footprint, zero button cutoff.
   - Collapsible Solution Panel on the right for full-screen drawing canvas.
2. Advanced Geometric Construction:
   - Pedagogical Dashed Line Tool [┈ Dashed]: Instant toggle between solid and dashed styling.
   - Clean Image Export: Pure white background, zero stray lines, auto-crop bounding box.
   - Smart Tangents: Automated common tangents (inner & outer) for 2 circles; dynamic interactive tangent for single circle.
   - Point Builder by Angle & Ratio (AM = k*BC, equal angles BME = ECA, degree angles).
   - Full Triangle Centers: Orthocenter (H), Incenter (I), Incircle, Circumcenter (O).
   - Standard Polygons: Parallelogram, Rhombus, Square.
3. Automated CAS Geometry Solver & Streaming:
   - SymPy algebraic solver for Coordinate Geometry (Oxy) & VMO Olympiad (2000, 2001, 2003, 2007, 2008).
   - Live typewriter / auto-streaming animation for step-by-step proofs.
   - Automatic invariant detection: Collinear, tangent, perpendicular, equal ratios.
4. Drawing Management:
   - Comprehensive Clipboard: Copy (Ctrl+C), Paste (Ctrl+V), Duplicate (Ctrl+D).
   - Non-destructive canvas clear (preserves problem statement & solution text).
   - Clean bilingual UI with instantaneous toggle between Tiếng Việt and English.

KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS:
• Ctrl + N: New blank drawing
• Ctrl + Z / Ctrl + Y: Undo / Redo
• Ctrl + C / Ctrl + V: Copy / Paste selected objects
• Ctrl + D: Quick duplicate selection
• Ctrl + A: Select all objects on canvas
• Delete: Erase selected objects
• Ctrl + H: Hide / Show auxiliary lines
• Ctrl + E: Export clean pedagogical PNG image
• Mouse Wheel: Zoom in / Zoom out canvas
• Right-click Drag: Pan canvas

about.tip_body: View version information, engine details and shortcuts.

clear_draw.tip_body: Clear all geometric objects while keeping problem statement intact.

hide.tip_body: Toggle hidden state of auxiliary lines.

lang_toggle.tip_body: Click to switch entire interface to Vietnamese.

rot_custom.tip_body: Enter exact degree angle to rotate.

rot_l.tip_body: Rotate all points counter-clockwise by 15 degrees.

rot_r.tip_body: Rotate all points clockwise by 15 degrees.

select_all.tip_body: Select all objects to move, copy or rotate.

angle_ratio_point.tip_body: Construct point M by angle condition (e.g. BME=ECA, 30°, 45°) or ratio (e.g. AM=2*CB).

bisector.tip_body: Click 3 points forming an angle (vertex in middle) to construct bisector.

erase.tip_body: Click on any point, segment, line or circle to delete.

intersection.tip_body: Click near intersection of 2 lines, line & circle, or 2 circles.

line.tip_body: Click two points to create an infinite line.

mark_angle.tip_body: Mark angle: Right (square), 1 arc, 2 arcs, arc with tick; with Greek symbols (α, β...) or degree (°).

midpoint.tip_body: Click two points to construct their midpoint.

parallel.tip_body: Click 1 point and 1 line to construct parallel line.

perpendicular.tip_body: Click 1 point and 1 line to construct perpendicular line.

point.tip_body: Click anywhere on the plane to place a new point.

proj_foot.tip_body: Drop orthogonal projection from point onto line (e.g. D = proj of M on BC).

rotate_mouse.tip_body: Drag mouse in circular motion to rotate all points interactively.

segment.tip_body: Click two points to create a segment.

select.tip_body: Click to select or drag objects. Double-click a point to rename.

toggle_dash.tip_body: Click any line segment or circle to toggle between Solid and Pedagogical Dashed line.

translate_vec.tip_body: Translate point by vector (e.g. vec(MN) = vec(AC)).

circle.tip_body: Click center point, then click a point on circumference.

circle_3p.tip_body: Click 3 points to construct circumcircle passing through them.

calc_area.tip_body: Select 3+ points (polygon/triangle) or 1 circle to compute area and shaded fill.

check_prop.tip_body: Click 3 points to test for Collinearity or Isosceles Triangle.

circumcenter.tip_body: Click 3 vertices to compute perpendicular bisectors intersection (O).

common_tangents.tip_body: Click 2 centers or 2 circles to construct common tangents.

incenter.tip_body: Click 3 vertices to compute angle bisectors intersection (Incenter I).

incircle.tip_body: Click 3 vertices to construct incircle touching all 3 sides.

orthocenter.tip_body: Click 3 vertices of triangle to construct orthocenter H.

parallelogram.tip_body: Click 3 vertices A, B, C. Vertex D is computed automatically.

rhombus.tip_body: Click 2 base points, then click a direction point.

smart_tangent.tip_body:
• Click 2 centers: automatically creates ALL common tangents!
• Click 1 circle: creates dynamic interactive tangent!

square.tip_body: Click 2 base points, other 2 vertices are constructed automatically.

btn_solve.tip_body: Analyze geometric relations and generate step-by-step SymPy proof.

btn_toggle_panel.tip_body: Click to expand canvas to full screen or restore solution panel.

tip_black: Change selected objects to print black.
tip_blue: Change selected objects to academic blue.
tip_red: Change selected objects to red (or set as default for next objects).
